mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p JOIN categories category ON category.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN running_records rr ON rr.post_id = p.post_id

SELECT p.post_id, category.name AS category_name, p.title, p.summary, CASE WHEN u.status = 'DELETED' THEN '탈퇴한 사용자' ELSE u.nickname END AS author_nickname, (SELECT pi.storage_key FROM post_images pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.post_id ORDER BY pi.display_order, pi.image_id LIMIT 1) AS storage_key, rr.distance_km, rr.duration_seconds, rr.location_name, rr.region, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comment_count FROM posts p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.author_id JOIN categories category ON category.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN running_records rr ON rr.post_id = p.post_id
ORDER BY
p.published_at ASC, p.post_id ASC (rr.distance_km IS NULL) ASC, rr.distance_km ASC, p.published_at DESC, p.post_id DESC (rr.distance_km IS NULL) ASC, rr.distance_km DESC, p.published_at DESC, p.post_id DESC (like_count + comment_count) DESC, p.published_at DESC, p.post_id DESC p.published_at DESC, p.post_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
